title: Claude role adapter
lead:
Run one role round with `claude -p` and turn its output into the engine's
result: command, stream, usage, exit class, resume and report
(`plan.s04-cut`).
boundary: **Not in this slice:** codex, grok, fallback, budgets, or the engine's state machine.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
S01 measured what claude's headless mode reports; this makes it the one
vendor S04's engine can run for real.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/agent/claude/` (new; `vendor.package-path`), using `internal/clirun` process groups, exported for it (`code.process-groups`).
- `testdata/vendors/claude/` fixtures (read; new ones only if redacted).
- Not `internal/engine` (S04); S17 joins the two.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- The command carries model, effort, `--output-format stream-json
  --verbose`, the allowlist for write roles and `--permission-mode plan`
  for read-only ones, and `--resume SESSION` on a resumed round.
- Stream events from the S01 fixtures give text deltas for an output tail,
  and the `result` event gives session id, final text, usage tokens and
  `total_cost_usd`.
- Exit class: ok; `permission_denials` non-empty is a denial even with
  exit 0; an auth error; any other failure is unclassified, and its raw
  stdout, stderr and JSON are saved as a fixture candidate under
  `~/.local/state/ork/fixtures/claude/` (`vendor.ratelimit-detection`).
  A rate-limit class comes only from a documented signal.
- The report comes from the report file, else the result text
  (`role.report-io`).
- Cancel kills the process group; no process is left running.
- A fake `claude` executable replays the fixtures; no real call.
